    How to read the numbers

      Built from public sources only. Site figures (stock, demand, tank sizes) are estimates until they are replaced with Aramco's own records, which is the first step of a pilot.

      Estimated demand = annual consumption + first fill of new plants + conversion of fluorinated AFFF stock to fluorine-free F3 (NFPA 11 sizing). Engineering estimates, not orders.
